methodology.name: Demand Growth Score
assumptions: -10% and +10% are fixed heuristic anchors chosen for this prototype, not FAA benchmarks or validated investment thresholds.
Zero growth maps to 50; this is the scale midpoint, not evidence of opportunity or profitability.
Values below -10% map to 0 and above +10% map to 100; saturation loses distinctions at the extremes.
The score depends only on growth, not the size of the airport or the comparison cohort.
Missing growth is unranked; it is never replaced by zero or an estimated value.
Passenger growth alone proves neither terminal expansion need nor financial profitability.
methodology.rankingRule: Descending unrounded score; tied scores ordered by ascending IATA code. Rank is an ordinal position.

limitations: Original PDF/XLSX files were not downloaded locally: FAA host DNS resolution failed. Counts come from documented browser-parsed PDF excerpts.
Coverage is limited to LAX, SFO and BOS; responses are not live FAA queries.
Enplanements are calendar-year passenger boardings, not total airport passengers or unique travelers.
The 2025 commercial-service PDF link contains an all-airports-by-state report.
Annual traffic does not measure terminal capacity or explain changes in demand.
Rankings cover only the validated local dataset, not the United States airport market.
Passenger growth alone is not proof of terminal expansion need or financial profitability.
